I am reaching out regarding ticket
ID0379441
for charger
0ywC0f.
The ticket is opened for incorrect visualization of the screensaver (a blue screen appears instead).
I had a talk with R&D and I got to know that a fix for this issue is already included in firmware v5.0.21, which has been released last week.
